title: NPC Pawnshops
body:
Builder: MSET <mob vnum> FLAGS ShopPawnshop. No other toggles or specialty fields are needed.
SELL <item> or SELL ALL <item> pawns transferable valued items at normal general-store prices; the pawnshop holds each item. LIST shows real stock. BUY <item> or BUY ALL <item> purchases that same item at 150% of the original payout; anyone can buy it back. Stock survives restarts. Worthless items, mission cargo, soulbound rewards and filled backpacks are refused. The four materials specialists use ShopMining, ShopFarming, ShopLumberjack, or ShopGemcutter flags.
